testInfo.description: oauth2as example OP, OIDC basic certification profile
testInfo.summary: This test calls the authorization endpoint test twice. The second time it waits 1 second and includes max_age=1, so that the authorization server is required to ask the user to login a second time and must return an auth_time claim in the second id_token. A screenshot of the second authorization should be uploaded.
